name: Collapse
summary: A single expandable panel that hides secondary content until asked.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-collapse> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the `open` attribute IS the state, and clicking the header toggles it while CSS animates the body height + caret on a persistent node — the transition always fires. The DS V3 Collapse is a family (a Collapse container + Collapse-Item), so one panel carries the whole matrix as attributes: `accordion` (one panel open at a time across siblings), bordered (default) vs `ghost` (borderless), `size` (default · small), `icon-position` (start · end), a `disabled` panel, and a slot="extra" header accessory. slot="header" is the summary, the default slot the body; the caret is an <aha-icon> from the DS library. Emits a composed `toggle` event.
codeNote: The open/close animation lives on a persistent node (the header toggles the `open` attribute; :host([open]) drives the CSS), so it never dies to a subtree rebuild — the Switch-click trap. `open` + `disabled` are observed, so setting them as controlled props keeps both the visuals AND the header's aria-expanded/aria-disabled in sync for a screen reader. `accordion` coordinates siblings: opening a panel closes its sibling accordion panels under the same parent. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Caret
spec.value: system-caret-right <aha-icon>, rotate 0°→90° on open, motion-mid ease-in-out

spec.label: Icon position
spec.value: start (leading, default) or end (trailing edge, via order)

props.name: open
props.desc: Whether the panel is expanded; toggled on header click (observed → aria-expanded synced)

props.name: accordion
props.desc: Opening this panel closes sibling accordion panels under the same parent (one-open-at-a-time)

props.name: ghost
props.desc: Borderless, transparent surface that sits seamlessly on the page

props.name: icon-position
props.desc: Caret on the leading or trailing edge of the header

props.name: extra
props.desc: A trailing header accessory (a tag, a count, an icon)

whenToUse.when: hiding secondary detail (advanced settings, an FAQ answer) until wanted
switching between peer views of equal importance
content that should always be visible

opinion.note: Header text names what's inside — 'Advanced settings', not 'More'. Keep panels shallow; deep nesting hides content people never find.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Collapse component-set taxonomy (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): a Collapse container + a Collapse-Item, mirroring antd — the container carries accordion / bordered vs ghost / size / expand-icon position, the item carries disabled + an extra accessory. DS V3's measured cell set has no Collapse px/rgb, so the look is derived from the token layer (radius-default, border, split, bg-hover, icon-default, text-disabled) + antd Collapse conventions. A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
